changes.after: El-Ahsa vahasının havasında kuşların sergilendiği bir bahçe.
changes.why: Three independent readers in a row stumbled on this one phrase (on-05 «ortamında», on-r1 «atmosferi içinde», on-r2 «atmosferinde») and all three named «havasında» / «havasını yansıtan» as the Turkish way; the stumble is the word, not the syntax (tr-attr-1 signal). The weather reading I held against «hava» does not hold here: in the genitive chain «vahanın havası» with a place as possessor, «hava» is the ordinary Turkish for ambience (şehrin havası, bayram havası), the readers themselves used it in that sense, and no sentence element (no season, no temperature) invites the weather reading. «havasında» keeps "amid the atmosphere of the oasis", adds no fact, reorders nothing. «kuşların sergilendiği» stays: the English "for displaying birds" says the birds are displayed.

rulings.title: El-Ahsa Misket Limonu Çiftliği; the fruit is «misket limonu», «(lomi)» Latin
rulings.ruling: Title «El-Ahsa Misket Limonu Çiftliği» (Hasawi rule: El-Ahsa + noun, no demonym, A9; P3 Lime Farm and Farm = Çiftlik as CATEGORY_LABELS.farm); the fruit «El-Ahsa misket limonu» in the summary and body; «misket limonu toplama mevsimi» in bestTime; «(lomi)» kept Latin once as the English has it. «limon» is rejected (it names the yellow lemon). Nothing says black, dried or kara (P7 stays open).
rulings.evidence: Stage 4 read tr.wikipedia «Misket limonu» (small dark-green citrus, "limondan fark edilir oranda küçük") and «Kurutulmuş misket limonu» (the loomi of Saudi and Gulf cooking; the encyclopedia's own word is misket limonu). TDK has «limon» (Citrus limonum, yellow) and «lim» ("küçük limon") and no «misket limonu» headword: the brief's "TDK separates them" is corrected. The page's own field-check comment (lemon-farm.md, 2026-08-29): Citrus aurantiifolia, green, a lime. The zh (青柠) precedent also keeps lime apart from lemon; ru ≈ лайм, de Limette.

rulings.title: Collision names: Es-Sevsen, Et-Taraf, Şark Restoranı, El-Hamidiye
rulings.ruling: All kept (A1-collisions: accepted as inherent, no respelling): «Es-Sevsen Kuş Bahçeleri» (السوسن, sun letter; echoes süsen = iris, a true cognate), «Et-Taraf Hayvanat Bahçesi» / «Et-Taraf kasabası», «Şark Restoranı» (مطعم شرق, A11-Sark), «El-Hamidiye Çarşısı» (P1 article; the Damascus souq is «Hamidiye Çarşısı (Şam)» on tr.wikipedia and El-Hamidiye in running text; the place Hüfuf beside the name in the summary, body and area row is the separation). The mitigation is the generic beside the name. Reader stumbles recorded: Sevsen/sevsen (item 18), Et/taraf (21), Şark (31), Kayseri echo of Kaysariye (33).
rulings.evidence: Reader items 18, 21, 31 against A1-collisions (Kare, Busalih, Kaysariye, Müberrez), A5-names-5 (Et-Taraf), A9-collisions (full name once, generic always) and P3's ban on respelling to escape a homograph (ru P8).

rulings.title: taraf-zoo.area takes «kasabası» (A5 open option ruled)
rulings.ruling: «Et-Taraf kasabası — Hüfuf'un doğusu». The body already says «Et-Taraf kasabası» for "the town of Al-Taraf"; the Arabic row says بلدة الطرف; the closest precedent, najim-museum.area (Arabic بلدة الجفر, English row without generic), was approved with the generic: «El-Cefr kasabası — El-Ahsa'nın doğusu» (A10-Cefr). A5-names-5's «Et-Taraf yakınları» (arbaa) is a different row ("near Al-Taraf") and stays.
rulings.evidence: tm pair najim-museum area; src/content/attractions/najim-museum.md area: بلدة الجفر / area_en without generic / area_tr with kasabası; taraf-zoo.md area: بلدة الطرف — شرق الهفوف; zh row 塔拉夫镇. Reader items 21, 28.

rulings.title: «Şark Restoranı» for Sharq Restaurant
rulings.ruling: Kept, built from مطعم شرق (P1–P4; ş for ش, k for ق); the dining page sharq-alqaisariah.md has no Turkish title; if it gets a title_tr this string follows it. «Qaisariyah» is the branch's name, not part of the restaurant's name, so «Kaysariye» is not added. Collision with «şark» (the East, dated; TDK «► doğu»): cognate with the Arabic name (شرق = East), mitigated by «Restoranı»; Latin «Sharq» not used (P2). Suffix: Şark Restoranı'nın / Şark Restoranı'nda (a named restaurant takes the apostrophe, like a place).
rulings.evidence: Stage 4: TDK şark; tr.wikipedia «Şark» → Doğu; dining page read; no Turkish page for the restaurant. Reader item 31 read it as "oriental restaurant, or the name?"; the summary, body, card and FAQ each have the generic beside it.

rulings.title: Hamidiye is a heritage landmark, not a working souq: wording in every string
rulings.ruling: «tarihî bir yapı» for "heritage landmark" (loses only the "landmark" shade, as source_defect records: «simge» banned A5-words, «önemli yer» adds a value judgement, «korunan» a protection status, «tarihî eser» a legal status); «artık çarşı olarak çalışmıyor» / «artık halk çarşısı olarak çalışmıyor» for "no longer trades as a souq / folk market" («çalışmak» is the verb of an open shop, «çalışan bir çarşı» is the card's and the FAQ question's phrase; «kullanılmıyor» would say "not used", «faaliyet göstermiyor» is bureaucratic); «içinde bugün Şark Restoranı hizmet veriyor». Present in summary, body (colon form), card value and FAQ 0. The «Güncel durum» row value is translated as given. The pending-confirmation sentence stays as the site's editorial sentence (P6 open).
rulings.evidence: Stage 2 and 4 weighed the alternatives; this judge re-read all four strings against the owner's ruling (CLAUDE.md: heritage landmark, no longer trades, activity in its building is Sharq Restaurant) and the Arabic (معلم تراثي لا سوق عامل; توقّف نشاطه بوصفه سوقاً شعبياً). Reader items 29, 35, 36, 38.

rulings.title: Place chain: «Kuzey er-Rifa mahallesinde, Kral Abdülaziz Yolu üzerindedir»; «Yolu» not «Caddesi»
rulings.ruling: The English "in the North Al-Rifaa district on King Abdulaziz Road" is two sentences in the body (the souq in central Hüfuf; the building in the district and on the road) and one clause with a semicolon in the FAQ: never three complements before a verb. «Kral Abdülaziz Yolu» (P3: Road is translated; the Arabic طريق; «Kral Fahd Yolu» is the form tr.wikipedia uses for a Saudi royal-named road). «Caddesi» (TDK cadde = ► ana yol, a city street) is recorded as the alternative, not adopted. «Kuzey er-Rifa mahallesi» follows A4/A10, always with «mahallesi».
rulings.evidence: Stage 4: tr.wikipedia «Riyad» («Kral Fahd Yolu olarak bilinen 65 numaralı karayolu»), TDK yol/cadde. This judge's own search for «Kral Abdülaziz Caddesi/Yolu» found no Turkish press hit for either (only a Saudi Arabic and an unrelated Kurdish source), so press usage is NOT established either way. Reader item 32 (Caddesi) is a taste preference; it does not overrule a sourced pattern.

rulings.title: Season words on the cards: plain, no dates
rulings.ruling: lemon-farm: «Her gün 16.00–21.30 (yetişme mevsimlerinde)» (tm pair verbatim; the parenthesis conditions the whole row as the published «Her gün 16.00–24.00 (fıskiye gösterileri gün batımından sonra)»; «yetişme» = the fruit grows, «tarım mevsimi» would read as a farming calendar). strawberry-farm: «Kış ve ilkbahar mevsimlerinde 15.30–21.30» (plural after reader item 13; no «Her gün» because the English has none). No season dates added anywhere.
rulings.evidence: English "Daily in the growing seasons, 4:00–9:30 pm"; "Winter and spring season, 3:30–9:30 pm"; Arabic المواسم الزراعية / الموسم الشتوي والربيعي; P10 form 16.00–21.30 / 15.30–21.30.

rulings.title: bestTime: «Haziran ortasından ağustos ayına kadar»
rulings.ruling: Kept as stage 4 edited it: a recurring season is not a date, so the month is lower case and takes no apostrophe (TDK Yazım Kuralları: «Belirli bir tarihi belirtmeyen ay ve gün adları küçük harfle başlar»); «ağustos ayına kadar» follows the published asfar «mayıs ayına kadar»; «Haziran» is capitalised only as the first word. This supersedes the brief's «Ağustos'a» example. A10-days capitalises day names in schedules for a reason that does not apply to a sentence-embedded month. The English open end "to August" is kept (item 5).
rulings.evidence: Stage 4 read tdk.gov.tr rules (büyük harflerin kullanıldığı yerler; kesme işareti); tm asfar bestTime; A10-days.

rulings.title: Edits of rounds 1 (five strings), 2 (three) and 3 (sawsan-gardens.summary and .body)
rulings.ruling: E1 strawberry-farm.practical.0.value (mevsimlerinde); E2 sawsan-gardens.summary and E3 .body (atmosferi içinde); E4 taraf-zoo.area (kasabası); E5 hamidiyah-souq.body (colon). No sentence is reordered, no fact added. Checklist for the proofreader and the fresh reader: E1 the season phrase; E2/E3 «atmosferi içinde» (does it read as "amid the atmosphere", and is body == summary); E4 the area row; E5 the colon sentence (subject of «çalışmıyor» and «hizmet veriyor»; «Bina» count). ROUND 2: E6 sawsan-gardens.summary and E7 .body «atmosferi içinde» to «atmosferinde» (plain locative, the independent proofread's own note; body == summary); E8 hamidiyah-souq.body, the second «bugün» removed (it is not in the English; "Today" and "no longer" stay, once each), both status halves kept. Not edited, with reasons: the four-time-word / repeated-fact count was the only on-r1 stumble that landed on an edited spot and asked for no new fact; all other on-r1 items repeat on-05 items already ruled, or are frame or source. Checklist for the fresh reader: sawsan-gardens.summary; hamidiyah-souq.body sentence 6. ROUND 3: E9 sawsan-gardens.summary and E10 .body «atmosferinde» to «havasında» (A11-sawsan-word); body == summary. Checklist for the fresh reader: sawsan-gardens.summary only.

rulings.title: Hamidiye body sentence 6: both status halves stay, one time word goes
rulings.ruling: «Günümüzde bina çalışan bir çarşı değil, tarihî bir yapıdır: artık halk çarşısı olarak çalışmıyor; içinde Şark Restoranı hizmet veriyor.» The English says "rather than a working souq" and, after the colon, "it no longer trades as a folk market": two statements, the second the reason for the first; the Arabic has both too. «çalışan bir çarşı değil» is the owner's landmark ruling in its own words and «halk çarşısı» is a narrower term (the tm pair for "folk souq"), so dropping the first half would leave the ruling to be inferred. «Günümüzde» (Today) and «artık» (no longer) are the English's; the second «bugün» was an addition and is removed.
rulings.evidence: EN body sentence 3; AR body; on-r1 p5#8; independent proofread 05d (colon form SOUND, "Günümüzde + artık mildly redundant but the source's own Today … no longer").

rulings.title: sawsan-gardens: «vahasının havasında» for "amid the atmosphere of the oasis"
rulings.ruling: Final: «El-Ahsa vahasının havasında kuşların sergilendiği bir bahçe.» Three words were tried in three readers (ortamında, atmosferi içinde, atmosferinde); each was called a calque and each reader named «havasında» (or «havasını yansıtan») as the Turkish way, so the word is the stumble, not the syntax. My round-1 objection (hava = weather) is withdrawn for this construction: with a place as possessor, «hava» is the common word for ambience (şehrin havası, bayram havası), and the sentence contains nothing (season, heat, sky) that makes the weather reading available. «kuşların sergilendiği» stays (English "for displaying birds").
rulings.evidence: on-05 p3#16; on-r1 p3#3; on-r2 p3#2; proofreads 05d and 05d-r2 (grammar sound in each form).

tm_pairs.en: In the town of Al-Taraf, east of Hofuf among the oasis villages, lies Al-Taraf Zoo, a family destination where children get to see a variety of animals up close. It is one of the area's simple, unhurried family outings, easily combined with a visit to the nearby Al-Taraf countryside and the southern reaches of the oasis. Check locally before planning the trip.

tm_pairs.en: Al-Hamidiyah Souq is a building in central Hofuf, in the North Al-Rifaa district on King Abdulaziz Road. It was restored as part of the development of historic downtown Hofuf, alongside the reconstruction of Qaisariyah Souq and the creation of the Craftsmen Souq, joining the cluster of heritage souq buildings at the city's core. Today it is a heritage landmark rather than a working souq: it no longer trades as a folk market, and the activity in its building is Sharq Restaurant. Further details of the building and its history are pending confirmation from reliable sources before being published here.
tm_pairs.tr: El-Hamidiye Çarşısı, Hüfuf'un merkezinde bir binadır. Bina, Kuzey er-Rifa mahallesinde, Kral Abdülaziz Yolu üzerindedir. Hüfuf'un tarihî şehir merkezini geliştirme çalışmaları kapsamında restore edildi. Bu çalışmalarla birlikte El-Kaysariye Çarşısı yeniden inşa edildi, Zanaatkârlar Çarşısı da kuruldu. Böylece bina, şehrin kalbindeki geleneksel çarşı binaları kümesine katıldı. Günümüzde bina çalışan bir çarşı değil, tarihî bir yapıdır: artık halk çarşısı olarak çalışmıyor; içinde Şark Restoranı hizmet veriyor. Binaya ve tarihine dair daha fazla ayrıntı, burada yayımlanmadan önce güvenilir kaynaklardan teyit edilmeyi bekliyor.
